final_lessons: Establishing baseline: prefer moderate-depth wide MLPs with layer norm for regression tasks.
Moderate depth (3) with reasonably wide layers and some layer norm tends to win regression.
Moderate depth (~3) with residual and layer norm remains a strong regression choice.
Deeper wide MLPs (depth-6, width-128) can outperform moderate-depth ones on this dataset.
Width matters most; depth-6 width-128 tends to give lowest MSE here.
Width 128 is the key driver of low MSE; pick the widest deep option.
Width-128 deep residual MLPs consistently dominate; choose them when available.
When width-128 is unavailable, deeper width-64 layer-normed nets beat shallow width-256 ones.
Width-128 depth-3 nets reliably outperform shallow width-256 and small nets.
Deep width-128 nets remain the top choice over shallow wide or narrow ones.
